data.name: In Time
data.detailed_description:
A catastrophic failure in Chronosyn’s time machine has returned the prehistoric, unleashing dinosaurs.

Agents of TAC have come together to fix this ‘Quantum Anomaly Generator’, and send the marauding predators back where they came from.

With no weapons other than wit and strategy, you’ll need to evade hungry foes, hiding in the environment or using it to your advantage to get away. Chronosyn conveniently left behind some wacky technology, some of which you can use to make a swift getaway or even capture the dinosaurs in pursuit!

But be warned, this mysterious corporation has protected their valuable data, and the firewalls need to be broken through before the modules can be downloaded.

While you’re busy hacking terminals, the big meat eaters might seem like enough to worry about, but there are an array of creatures patrolling these areas.

Some of the smaller dinosaurs might not be deadly, but cutting off the power of your generator or calling for help from a bigger and hungrier creature will keep you on your toes! Working with your team to create or use distractions will be vital to get what you need without becoming lunch.

Should the food chain catch up with you, a side effect of the time machine might have you find that you’ve started to look like the creatures around you. Don’t panic, there are devices scattered around the world that can bring you back to normal. The big meat eaters won’t find you so appetizing in this form either, but look out for the smaller dinosaurs who might see a new opportunity!

data.short_description: In Time is a 4 player online co-op adventure. Chronosyn’s strange machine has brought back the dinosaurs, and only you and your team can set things back to normal. Explore an ever-changing environment and make it back to the machine all while hungry predators stalk your path.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Quad core Intel or AMD (2.5 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
